g.text: Sequence Diagram - Pre-Trial Case Management Hearing (Order XV-A CPC)
Login with Bar Council ID & Password
User details (Role: Advocate, Bar Reg: MP/4821)
Navigate to Active Case & Open Admissions Matrix
Query Admission Items (Plaint & Written Statement assertions)
Mark Statement (ADMITTED / DENIED / REQUIRES_PROOF) + upload exhibit
2. Court Fee Verification via Cyber Treasury MP
Submit Commercial Court Fee Challan for Case Management
Validate Cyber Treasury Reference Number (CRN) & Amount
200 OK (Status: PAID, Bank: SBI Cyber Treasury Indore, ₹12,500)
Update Case Record (Fee Verified = True, e-Challan Linked)
3. Pre-Trial Case Management Hearing (CMH) & Clash-Free Scheduling
Initiate First CMH Scheduling (Order XV-A Rule 1 CPC)
Check Advocate Courtroom Clashes & Bench Availability
Query active Advocate hearings across High Court Benches
Availability Matrix (Indore Bench Court Room 4, 11:30 AM Slot Available)
Create Hearing Docket Entry & WebRTC Virtual Courtroom Room ID
4. Virtual CMH Hearing & Automated Case Management Order (CMO)
Review Uncontested Facts & Extract Triable Issues
Generate Draft CMO (Order XV-A Rule 2 CPC Timetable)
Pull Formulated Admitted Facts & Narrowed Issues
Draft CMO Timetable (Inspection, Interrogatories, Witness Affidavits, Trial Date)
Approve & Digitally Seal CMO (Judicial DSC Applied)
Store Sealed CMO with Hash & Timestamp
Registry Docket Updated with Cause List Entry
